backingPerToken().notice: rfv() / totalSupply, WAD USDG per whole NET. The protocol NAV.

liquidUsdg().notice: Un-deployed USDG held by the treasury, WAD.

mintNet(address,uint256).notice: Mints NET to `to`. Authorized minters only (fixed at deploy:         Distributor, GenesisBond, BondDepository, PremiumSeller, pTEAM).

morphoAssets().notice: Current Morpho position in USDG terms (pre-haircut), WAD.

morphoCapBps().notice: Max fraction of treasury USDG deployable to Morpho, bps (7000).

rebalanceFromMorpho(uint256).notice: Withdraws USDG from the Morpho vault back to liquid reserves.

rebalanceToMorpho(uint256).notice: Deposits idle USDG into the Morpho vault up to the 70% cap.         Keeper entrypoint; precondition-checked on-chain.

rfv().notice: Risk-free value of reserves, WAD USDG terms:         liquid USDG + Morpho position × (1 − 2% haircut) + POL RFV         (2·sqrt(x·y) v2 convention). specs/treasury.md §2.

spendUsdg(address,uint256).notice: Transfers USDG (raw token units) to `to`. Authorized spenders         only (fixed at deploy: InverseBond). Unwinds Morpho if liquid         balance is insufficient (specs/treasury.md §2).
